_: Why each scripts/data/book-names.json alias that changes the book's TITLE still names the SAME book. Owner, 2026-09-25 (desk #166, 'Middle way'): a '(Remastered)' printing may fold into its own book (same book, newer printing); different books are never folded together. scripts/reprint-check.mjs CHECK 4 fails on a renaming alias with no line here, and on a line here whose alias neither renames nor folds one printing into the other. Prefixes ('Pathfinder', 'Paizo', 'Lost Omens', 'Adventure:', 'Adventure Path:', 'Blog:'), a leading 'The' and '(Remastered)' do not count as a rename; an alias that folds a legacy title into its '(Remastered)' key may say why here too.
Abomination Vaults Hardcover: same book: the Archives' short title for the Abomination Vaults Hardcover Compilation.
Azarketi Ancestry Web Supplement: same book: the free web supplement reprints the azarketi chapter of Absalom, City of Lost Omens. The Archives list the ancestry (ancestry-41) and its two weapons (weapon-155, weapon-156) under the supplement alone; they keep the Absalom key they had before desk #166, so a character with Absalom on keeps them (the #166 rule applied, 2026-09-25).
Dark Archive: same book, older printing: the Archives title the legacy Dark Archive 'Dark Archive' and its reprint 'Dark Archives (Remastered)'. Desk #166 folds a (Remastered) printing into its own book, so a record built on a legacy document carries the one Dark Archive (Remastered) key; without this line mapBook wrote 'Pathfinder Dark Archive', a second Dark Archive row on the Sources card (items/mind-weapon, items/mind-smiths-keepsake, actions/binding-vow, 2026-09-25). A saved Sources choice is left as the player set it: Dark Archive (Remastered) had a row of its own (src/rules/sources.ts BOOK_FOLDS).
Dark Archives (Remastered): same book: the Archives spell the remastered Dark Archive with a trailing 's'; the records and the Sources card use 'Dark Archive (Remastered)' (see scripts/lib/aon-facets.mjs canonBookName).
Fists of the Ruby Phoenix Hardcover: same book: the Archives' short title for the Fists of the Ruby Phoenix Hardcover Compilation.
Gatewalkers Player's Guide: same book, older printing: the legacy Gatewalkers Player's Guide, reprinted as 'Gatewalkers Player's Guide (Remastered)' (background-349 Wishes for Riches as background-580). Desk #166 folds a (Remastered) printing into its own book. The importer's lookup already set '(Remastered)' aside, but scripts/lib/aon-facets.mjs canonBookName reads this table by exact title, and backgrounds/wish-for-riches kept the legacy spelling from the Foundry era (2026-09-25). Both spellings sat in the one 'Gatewalkers' row on the Sources card at v0.1.40, so an old selection with that row on keeps the guide on (src/rules/sources.ts BOOK_FOLDS).
Gatewalkers (Hardcover): same book: Heroes Heaven names the collected Gatewalkers hardcover 'Adventure Path: Gatewalkers' (src/rules/sources.ts apBundleLabel); no volume of the Adventure Path maps here.
Myth-Speakers Players Guide: same book: the Archives' spelling of the Myth-Speaker Player's Guide (plural and apostrophe).
Pathfinder Beginner Box: Game Master's G: same book: the 2020 Beginner Box Game Master's Guide (source-63 / source-324) and Secrets of the Unlit Star (source-326, 2026-05-06) are one product line, the second its remastered printing — the #166 rule's 'same book, newer printing', so it folds into the Unlit Star label (desk #166 applied, 2026-09-25).
